aggregate_comparison.scope: Same mathematical aggregate closure; literal upper bounds may differ under outward arithmetic schedules. Numerical difference is reported, not treated as exact equality.

production_hierarchy_audit.scope: Complete frozen cohort, common full tails, all failure statuses and exact parent/current minimum hierarchy. This audit does not infer that an endpoint bound is globally optimal.

independent_geometry_audit.scope: Independent centred exponential-polynomial construction and literal scalar transforms on a 16-node audit grid. Tests implementation for dimensions 1,3,7, all admitted moment kinds and transport measures; not an additional financial result.

scope: Exact rho0/rho2 cell transforms checked against independent positive interval quadrature; positive-atom block closures checked under refinement. Production block transforms are compared with literal 768-bit Gaussian cell sums after source freeze.
